# NFSU.cc — Need for Speed Underground (2003) in Your Browser

> Play the original 2003 PC version of Need for Speed Underground free in a browser tab at https://nfsu.cc/ — no download, no install, no emulator.

NFSU.cc is a static recompilation of the original 2003 Windows executable (`Speed.exe`, 13,764 x86 functions lifted to C and compiled to WebAssembly) with a browser host layer replacing Windows, DirectX 9 (via WebGPU with automatic WebGL 2 fallback), DirectInput (keyboard, gamepad, touch), and DirectSound (Web Audio). It includes the full game (Quick Race, Go Underground career, garage and tuning, Olympic City at night, full original soundtrack) in both **Original 2003** and **Remaster** modes.

## Play & Entry Points

- [Play Need for Speed Underground Online](https://nfsu.cc/): Main entry point (opens the launcher on desktop, launches directly with touch controls on phones and tablets).
- [Launcher & Settings](https://nfsu.cc/launcher.html): Quality presets (Low / Medium / High / Ultra), Original 2003 vs Remaster, controls remapping, and local save backup/restore.
- [Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/Caliko06/need-for-speed-underground-browser): Static recompiler (`tools/recomp/`), browser host (`host/`, `web/`), reverse engineering census (`census/`), and system notes (`docs/re/`).

## Player Guides (English)

- [All English Guides](https://nfsu.cc/blog/en/index.html)
- [How to Play Need for Speed Underground Online](https://nfsu.cc/blog/en/play-need-for-speed-underground-online.html): Requirements, first load size (~32 MB), Original vs Remaster, local saves, and FAQ.
- [Controls: Keyboard, Gamepad and Phone](https://nfsu.cc/blog/en/need-for-speed-underground-controls-keyboard-gamepad-phone.html): Full key map, Xbox/PlayStation gamepad layout, remapping, and touch controls.
- [Browsers, Phones and Performance Settings](https://nfsu.cc/blog/en/browsers-phones-performance-settings.html): WebGPU and WebGL 2 browser support, phone lite build (448 MB WASM), and quality options.
